# L2TLB-PORT-02: both ports request concurrently and both complete.
async def test_two_ports_same_cycle(l2tlb_env):
    env = l2tlb_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await _prepare(env)
        env.walk_script = None
        _build(env, 0x28000, 0x111, mid=0x80009, leaf=0x8000A)
        _build(env, 0x2A000, 0x222, mid=0x80009, leaf=0x8000B)
        env.resp["ready"].Set(1)
        env.req["valid"].Set(1)
        env.req["vpn"].Set(0x28000)
        env.req1["valid"].Set(1)
        env.req1["vpn"].Set(0x2A000)
        accepted0 = accepted1 = False
        for _ in range(20):
            if not accepted0 and env.read(env.req["ready"]):
                accepted0 = True
                env.req["valid"].Set(0)
            if not accepted1 and env.read(env.req1["ready"]):
                accepted1 = True
                env.req1["valid"].Set(0)
            if accepted0 and accepted1:
                break
            await env.edge()
        assert accepted0 and accepted1
        env.req["valid"].Set(0)
        env.req1["valid"].Set(0)
        seen = {}
        for _ in range(4000):
            await env.service_memory(1)
            if env.read(env.resp["valid"]):
                seen["p0"] = env.read(env.resp["s1_ppn"])
            if env.read(env.resp1["valid"]):
                seen["p1"] = env.read(env.resp1["s1_ppn"])
            if seen.get("p0") is not None and seen.get("p1") is not None:
                break
        assert seen.get("p0") == (0x111 >> 3), seen
        assert seen.get("p1") == (0x222 >> 3), seen
